source.title: Thermodynamic speed limits in isolated quantum systems
source.author: Rikuya Kobashi

candidate_bound_family: tau >= ln(d/(d-1)) * W_q^G / average_gibbs_entropy_production_rate for finite d
mandatory_inputs: Hamiltonian family H(t) and protocol duration
theorem assumptions such as passivity/macroscopic-state conditions
definition and calculation of Vu-Saito quantum Wasserstein pseudo-distance
entropy production and average rate with explicit units
solver/version, numeric precision, seeds and artifact hashes
frozen_case_families: held-out Hamiltonian families not used to tune any estimator
mandatory_counterexamples: non-passive initial state outside the stated theorem domain
unitarily equivalent states with zero pseudo-distance but unequal density operators
acceptance_predicates: all in-domain inequalities verified from the paper's definitions
dimensional consistency and assumptions explicitly checked
no untracked counterexample or numerical failure
comparison against incumbent bounds uses identical state-transition and energy conventions
independent derivation and independently implemented calculation agree
held-out Hamiltonian family remains untouched until final evaluation
rejection_predicates: silent conversion of unknown or zero entropy-production rate
no tighter bound on any declared mission-relevant case

resource_accounting.note: Null means unmeasured, not zero; this protocol has not been executed.

next_gate: Implement deterministic exact-small-system fixture; freeze expected values and hashes; compare candidate and incumbent bounds; retain positive and negative cases.
